articles.title: Tea break & an alert driver: How Kailash pilgrims narrowly escaped Nepal floods
articles.description: Twenty-eight pilgrims from three Indian states safely returned home after escaping Nepal's devastating flash floods. A brief tea break and a ten-minute delay proved crucial in saving their lives. Another group's visa delay inadvertently kept them from the flood zone. They witnessed buses and villages being swept away by the raging waters. Officials are coordinating efforts to rescue other stranded pilgrims from Andhra Pradesh.

articles.title: 4 days under debris, still alive: How a 97-year-old woman survived Nepal floods
articles.description: In an inspiring tale of survival, a 97-year-old woman managed to endure four harrowing days trapped in rubble after the catastrophic flash floods in Nepal. Rescue teams are still combing through the obliterated regions for additional survivors. Although some individuals fled to safety, many families are left mourning their missing members and the devastation of their homes, revealing a bittersweet mix of hope and tragedy in this dire situation.

articles.title: Is the viral video really Kai Cenat being assaulted by police? Here’s the truth
articles.description: A misidentified viral video showing a police altercation has led many to erroneously believe that streamer Kai Cenat is involved. The clip, which actually depicts a traffic stop in Arkansas, features a man who resisted an officer's commands. This individual's likeness to Cenat has fueled the false narrative, which quickly gained traction on social media.

articles.title: Kim Jong UN shakes up North Korea’s military, dismisses defence minister No Kwang Chol
articles.description: North Korea has shaken up its military hierarchy by removing the defense minister, a move approved by Kim Jong Un in a recent leadership meeting. This change mirrors advancements at the nation's weapons research center, which has introduced new combat weapon systems. As tensions rise, trilateral military drills involving South Korea, the US, and Japan will carry on, designed to counter North Korea's ongoing nuclear and missile provocations.

articles.title: Bank holidays in September 2026: When and where will banks remain closed? Check state-wise list
articles.description: In September, banks throughout India will close for various festive occasions. On September 4th, multiple states will celebrate Janmashtami, resulting in branch closures. Following this, Ganesh Chaturthi on September 14th and 15th will also see numerous banks shut across different regions. Additional local holidays and elections will contribute to this schedule. However, customers can continue to access ATMs and digital banking services during these times.

articles.title: US-Venezuela energy pact: What we know about Trump’s ‘biggest oil deal in world history’
articles.description: In a landmark move, the United States and Venezuela have forged a 25-year energy partnership designed to uplift Venezuela's ailing oil sector and enhance production capabilities. Under this agreement, rights to unexplored oil reserves will be held for a century, with the U.S. claiming fifty-five percent of the new venture's output. This collaboration promises to inject significant investments and generate tax income for Venezuela.

articles.description: Filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma's recent social media posts have drawn attention from internet users. Many interpret his remarks as indirect criticisms of Yash's film 'Toxic'. Varma's posts, including one about Adolf Hitler, are being linked to the movie's box office collections. He previously commented on the clash between 'Toxic' and his film 'Dhurandhar'. The article notes 'Toxic' has received mixed reviews and declining box office numbers.
